description: This file defines database query functions related to user management, cart handling, and order ownership, primarily for a food ordering backend application.

methods.name: findUserByEmail(email)
methods.description: Finds a user by email, returning a row or null.

methods.name: createUser({ email, hashed_password, full_name, phone, role = 'customer' })
methods.description: Creates a new user with hashed password and other details, returning the new user id.

methods.name: getActiveCart(userId)
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an active cart for a given user.

methods.name: addItemToCart(cartId, menuItemId, quantity, unitPriceCents, currency = 'USD', notes = null)
methods.description: Adds or updates an item in a cart, behaving like an upsert.

methods.name: getOrderOwner(orderId)
methods.description: Returns the user_id associated with a given order.

ctags.name: addItemToCart
ctags.pattern: /^async function addItemToCart(cartId, menuItemId, quantity, unitPriceCents, currency = 'USD', not/
ctags.signature: (cartId, menuItemId, quantity, unitPriceCents, currency = 'USD', notes = null)

ctags.name: createUser
ctags.pattern: /^async function createUser({ email, hashed_password, full_name, phone, role = 'customer' }) {$/
